name: Copista de Emergência
prompt: Create exclusive artwork for medieval fantasy TCG card "Copista de Emergência". Card type Creature, subtypes Humano, Mago. Mechanical narrative to visualize, without writing it: Ao entrar, você pode colocar um Feitiço da sua mão no fundo do grimório. Se fizer isso, compre uma carta.. Scene: an urgent human wizard scribe in blue robes slides an old spell folio under a large bound grimoire, discovering a fresh luminous page in a coastal medieval library. Fine detailed oil painting, visibly painterly brushwork, convincing anatomy and aged materials, dramatic blue magical light balanced with amber candlelight, deep architectural background. Landscape 4:3, central crop-safe subject. No words, letters, numbers, symbols resembling writing, UI, card border, frame, signature or watermark. Match rich painted medieval fantasy illustration.

inspection.notes: Inspected rendered original: detailed painted human wizard and folio exchange, central subject, landscape; no UI/frame/signature.
